actionConfiguration.body:
select *
from public.save_ingredient(
	{{
	appsmith.store.IngForm_mode === "edit"
	? Number(appsmith.store.IngForm_edit_id || 0)
	: 0
	}},
	'{{ appsmith.store.current_client_id }}'::uuid,
	'{{
	JSON.stringify({
		name: inpIngIngredient.text?.trim() || "",
		category_id:
		selIngCategory.selectedOptionValue || null,

		purchase_unit_id:
		selIngPurchaseUnit.selectedOptionValue || null,

		purchase_qty:
		inpIngQuantity.text || null,

		total_cost:
		inpIngPurchaseCost.text || null,

		wastage_percent:
		inpIngWastage.text || 0,

		supplier_id:
		selIngSupplier.selectedOptionValue || null,

		packaging_id:
		selIngPackaging.selectedOptionValue || null,

		item_code:
		inpIngSupplierCode.text?.trim() || null,

		notes:
		rteIngNotes.text || null,

		active:
		chkIngActive.isChecked !== false,

		allergen_ids:
		msIngAllergens.selectedOptionValues || [],

		diet_tag_ids:
		msIngDietTags.selectedOptionValues || []
	}).replaceAll("'", "''")
	}}'::jsonb
);
